note: Local decision-path latency and provider RTT are measured and reported SEPARATELY. They are never combined.

localDecisionPath.source: docs/evidence/post-17-9/semantic-observation/performance_results.json and docs/evidence/post-17-9/m8-phone-detection/performance_results.json (measured on this machine, jsdom/Node, real production functions)

semantic_observation_adversarial.scope: 30 regions, long text, injection + PII candidates

localDecisionCycleLatency.scope: perception, grounding, M5, effect verification (README, pre-existing)

publishedBaseline.note: Reported as published by the project; NOT re-measured in this audit.

providerRtt.unit: milliseconds, measured separately from local latency
providerRtt.note: Free-tier provider. Rate limiting (HTTP 429/503) has been observed in earlier runs and is handled fail-closed.

verdict: Local path cost is dominated by the pre-existing world-model build; both post-17.9 additions are <1ms at p95. Provider RTT dominates end-to-end task time by two to three orders of magnitude and is reported separately.
